skills.name: afk
skills.description: Explicitly mark the human operator as physically away, persist the AFKSwitch state, and tell every other live local agent session when the host provides native cross-session messaging. Use only when the user explicitly invokes /afk; never trigger it because a conversation mentions leaving, sleeping, or being away.
headings: 2. Notify live sibling sessions (Claude Code reference adapter)
skills.description_zh: 仅在用户明确调用 /afk 时记录操作者离开状态并持久化 AFKSwitch；宿主支持原生跨会话消息时通知其他本地智能体会话，普通提及离开或睡觉不触发。

skills.name: back
skills.description: Explicitly mark the human operator as physically present again from any session, persist the AFKSwitch state, tell every other live local agent session, request a short status from each when the host supports it, and consolidate what needs the human first. Use only when the user explicitly invokes /back; never trigger it because a conversation mentions returning.
headings: 2. Notify live sibling sessions and request status (Claude Code reference adapter)
skills.description_zh: 仅在用户明确调用 /back 时记录操作者返回并持久化 AFKSwitch；宿主支持时通知其他本地会话、请求简短状态并汇总优先需要人工处理的事项。
